name: ImmPort_search_studies
description: Search ImmPort studies by keyword with optional species and client-side substring filters. Results use the official raw-hit fromRecord pagination: pass metadata.next_from_record as from_record while metadata.has_more is true. This is especially important with client-side filters, because a window may contain fewer filtered studies than limit.

condition_or_disease.description: Filter by disease/condition (e.g., 'influenza', 'malaria', 'HIV', 'dengue', 'tuberculosis'). Client-side substring match.

assay_method.description: Filter by assay method (e.g., 'Flow Cytometry', 'ELISPOT', 'RNA sequencing', 'ELISA', 'CyTOF', 'Luminex xMAP'). Client-side substring match.

research_focus.description: Filter by research focus (e.g., 'Vaccine Response', 'Infection Response', 'Immune Response', 'Transplantation', 'Autoimmune'). Client-side substring match.

species.description: Filter by species (e.g., 'Homo sapiens', 'Mus musculus'). Applied server-side.

limit.description: Maximum number of studies to return (1-100, default 10)

from_record.description: Zero-based ImmPort raw search-hit offset (official fromRecord parameter).
